items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: And by the miracle of the surgery done by Dr. Moss [Sterns,] Jr., in New York

ctx.x: Well, briefly I had a tumor in my

intestines, the lower part of my intestines, which was malignant. And by the miracle of the surgery done by Dr. Moss [Sterns,] Jr., in New York, in the Memorial Hospital and the advice of another very fine surgeon, Dr. Ira [McCowen,] they were able to remove this tumor and put me back into position where I can enjoy more or less a normal life, which I'm very thankful for. And that was the extent of it.
Well, the percentage of luck there was -- I mean, you did awfully well, didn't you?
